description:
GEØ.IA brings together mathematics, data science and a young explorer's curiosity: Adriele Jardim (mathematics researcher), Geovanna Lim (founder of GEØ.AI and data scientist) and Ana Luiza dos Reis de Mello (elementary school student). We share one rule: every answer must be traceable to open data, and every limit must be stated. Built for NASA Space Apps 2026.

Meet the team: https://geoia-spaceapps.vercel.app/#team
